name: Default 5x5 risk ranking (FI / SI / RI / SIL)

sources.frequency_index: Adapted (reworded) from the frequency index used by Ahn et al. (2019), Int. J. Hydrogen Energy 44(5):3185-3194, doi:10.1016/j.ijhydene.2018.12.065, which rates frequency per ship-year. Here 'installation' replaces 'ship'.
sources.severity_index: Adapted (reworded) from the severity index used by Ahn et al. (2019), same reference.
sources.risk_index: RI = FI x SI, as in Ahn et al. (2019).
sources.sil_matrix: Illustrative default written for this repository. It follows the general idea of a calibrated risk matrix in IEC 61511-3 (higher unmitigated risk -> higher required SIL) but it is NOT a normative table and it is NOT taken from Ahn et al. (2019). Replace it with your project's calibrated matrix.

convention: FI and SI describe the scenario BEFORE credit is taken for the listed safeguards (unmitigated), so that the ratings can be compared with a reference worksheet that uses the same convention.

frequency_index.label: Frequent
frequency_index.description: about once a year or more at one installation (F > 1/yr)

frequency_index.label: Occasional
frequency_index.description: once in 1-10 years at one installation (1/10 yr < F < 1/yr)

frequency_index.label: Rare
frequency_index.description: once in 10-100 years at one installation (1/100 yr < F < 1/10 yr)

frequency_index.label: Remote
frequency_index.description: once in 100-1000 years at one installation (1/1000 yr < F < 1/100 yr)

severity_index.label: Catastrophic
severity_index.description: multiple fatalities; uncontrolled environmental impact; loss up to about 200 MUSD

severity_index.label: Major
severity_index.description: single fatality or multiple severe injuries; severe environmental impact; loss up to about 20 MUSD

severity_index.label: Moderate
severity_index.description: multiple or severe injuries; major environmental impact; loss up to about 2 MUSD

severity_index.label: Significant
severity_index.description: single or minor injury; detectable environmental impact; loss up to about 200 kUSD

severity_index.label: Minor
severity_index.description: no injury; negligible environmental impact; loss up to about 20 kUSD

sil_values.0: no SIL requirement (basic process control / alarms are adequate)

sil_matrix.layout: rows = SI (1..5), columns = FI (1..5); value = suggested target SIL for an added safety function
